text:
frank: heads-up — trying to cut the JS SDK release for the sample app. publish pipeline failed the semver gate because a regendiff shows only example JSON property reordering in generated types. blocked.

leah: can you paste the tiny diff output?

frank: sure — regendiff top:```diff
-  examples:
-    - name: welcome
-      value: {
-        "user": "anna",
-        "message": "hi"
-      }
+  examples:
+    - name: welcome
+      value: {
+        "message": "hi",
+        "user": "anna"
+      }
```Only key order changed, no type/interface changes.

oscar: that matches the typegen change we shipped: stringify now sorts keys for determinism (typegen v0.15). The codegen output is consistent but regendiff treats any generated-file diffs as semver-impacting.

regendiff-bot: Automated check: regen diff detected in packages/sdk-js/generated/chatExamples.ts. Classified: examples-only. Semver-lens: candidate minor bump (by file-diff heuristic).

build-bot: CI: publish pipeline #2851 failed at regendiff step — semver-check exit 1. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/2851/logs

leah: quick unblock options: (1) manual override in release-cli (fast, but noisy), (2) patch regendiff to canonicalize example values before diffing (better long-term), (3) postgen shim to restore historical ordering pre-regen (surgical but brittle). Thoughts?

oscar: I'd rather fix regendiff comparator so it normalizes JSON example objects (and arrays) before computing semantic diffs. That avoids hacks in generated files and prevents future churn across languages. I'll prototype a canonicalizer that parses YAML/JS files and normalizes example value nodes using json-stable-stringify with a key-order whitelist.

frank: for today we need a publish. leah, can release-cli do a one-off bypass if oscar opens a PR with tests?

release-cli: Yes, we support a manual bypass for emergencies. Please attach a short PR + changelog note explaining "examples-only key reordering" and link it in the release UI. We log the override.

oscar: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/pull/602 — adds examples-canonicalizer and tests for nested maps/arrays. It also supports an opt-in header `// regen:ignore-example-order` so generated files can declare intent.

regendiff-bot: Noted new commit 1c4d9 in dev-tools. Re-running regendiff using patched comparator in a feature branch...

build-bot: CI: publish pipeline #2852 re-run — regendiff now reports "examples-only ordering change ignored". No semver bump detected.

frank: great — proceeding with `yarn lerna publish from-package --yes`. Thanks. :tada:

leah: follow-ups: (1) land the canonicalizer across all language dev-tools, (2) add guidance to the release playbook re: regenerations and example ordering, (3) consider switching the change detector to ignore generated examples by default unless the payload changes.

oscar: filing follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/issues/217 — expand canonicalization to include example arrays and preserve explicit ordering when generator annotates it.

frank: publish succeeded. closing loop. will watch for any SDK parity fallout in python/sdk. :shipit:
